name: Labor of Love
source:
A struggling writer gets swept up in a long overdue vacation with his wolf, only to finally have inspiration strike. Terrified of losing it, he might go a step too far in pursuit of his labor of love.

[From [url=https://rainy-midwest-studios.itch.io/labor-of-love]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位创作陷入困境的作家，与自己的狼伴踏上了早就该成行的假期，终于迎来灵感。他害怕失去这份灵感，或许会为倾注心血的创作而走得太远。

[摘自[url=https://rainy-midwest-studios.itch.io/labor-of-love]itch.io[/url]]
